world.title: Why Mamdani features alongside Iran, Hezbollah leaders on Netanyahu billboard
world.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party has placed New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on a campaign billboard in Tel Aviv alongside leaders from Iran, Hezbollah, and Turkey. This move intensifies the ongoing public feud as Israel approaches its October elections, coinciding with stalled ceasefire efforts in Gaza. The billboard aims to highlight perceived threats to Israel's security.

world.title: British student says he was denied entry to the US despite having valid visa only because he is Muslim: 'Felt as if I was kidnapped'
world.summary: Laith Alani, a 20-year-old British student, reported being denied entry to the US despite holding a valid visa, claiming the decision was based on his Muslim faith. He described his experience at Orlando International Airport as feeling like a kidnapping after being detained by Customs and Border Protection (CBP). The incident has raised concerns about discrimination.

world.title: Immigration department releases monthly update on application processing
world.summary: On August 18, 2026, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) released updated data on application processing for permanent residence, temporary residence, and citizenship. The figures, accurate as of June 30, 2026, were made available on the government’s “Inside IRCC’s application processing system” webpage, providing insights into the number of applications processed during that period.

business.title: The ethanol-in-petrol row: Could E10 make comeback alongside E20?
business.summary: The government faces opposition to E20 fuel, with critics citing reduced mileage and increased engine wear in older vehicles. They argue that these engines are not designed for higher ethanol blends. In response, the government claims any mileage drop would be minimal, between 3-5%, and emphasizes E20's advantages as a superior fuel, rejecting concerns about its impact.

business.title: YouTube revises view counting
business.summary: YouTube has announced a change in its view counting system, effective August 24. Views will now be counted as soon as a video starts, which is expected to increase view counts for creators. This adjustment aligns with the platform’s goal to provide a more accurate representation of viewership. The change aims to enhance the experience for both creators and viewers.

business.title: 'They knew': US states accuse Meta of hiding Instagram's impact on teenagers
business.summary: Lawyers for 29 US states have accused Meta of concealing internal research indicating that Instagram may be addictive for teenagers. This claim was made as part of a significant legal battle against the company. The states allege that Meta was aware of the potential negative impacts of its platform on young users but failed to disclose this information.

technology.title: click menu needs fixing — but there is already a better option
technology.summary: Microsoft is testing a customizable right-click menu for Windows Insiders, aiming for improved speed and usability, though no public release date has been set. While the native update offers easier controls, third-party app extensions may clutter the context menu and slow down loading times. Alternatives like Nilesoft Shell provide a cleaner menu experience for users seeking efficiency.

technology.title: VALORANT 2026 Sage guide: How to play and master the agent; Key tips and tricks explained
technology.summary: Sage is a unique agent in VALORANT, known for her versatility and valuable abilities. Mastering her skills requires practice and strategic decision-making. While she is classified as a Sentinel, Sage provides more than just defensive utility, making her effective in various situations. Understanding the timing and application of her abilities is crucial for less experienced players to succeed.

technology.title: Spotify rolling out 'User Notes' and 'Running Mode' features on Android
technology.summary: Spotify is launching two new features on Android: “Running Mode” and “User Notes.” The “Running Mode” automatically adjusts songs and playlists to match the user’s workout pace. Meanwhile, “User Notes” allows users to leave notes throughout their music library for future reference. These features aim to enhance user experience and personalization within the Spotify app.

sports.title: Fermin Lopez happy to play false nine for Barcelona after Robert Lewandowski and Ferran Torres exits
sports.summary: Fermin Lopez expressed confidence in playing as a false nine for Barcelona after the departures of Robert Lewandowski and Ferran Torres. He highlighted his experience in the position, indicating readiness to step up. Barcelona continues to seek a new striker before the transfer window closes, but Lopez's potential role may fill the gap left by the departing players.

sports.title: José Mourinho: “Real Madrid is on a different level, it can’t have players who think twice about joining”
sports.summary: Real Madrid coach José Mourinho discussed his evolution since returning to the club in an interview with El Chiringuito. He emphasized that Real Madrid operates at a different level and cannot accommodate players who hesitate to join. Mourinho reflected on his personal and professional growth, highlighting significant changes in his approach as both a person and a coach.

sports.title: The best Real Madrid starting XI in a 4
sports.summary: Jose Mourinho is expected to implement a 4-2-3-1 formation for Real Madrid, based on observations from preseason activities. This tactical approach will be utilized as the team prepares for their opening La Liga match against Espanyol. The formation reflects Mourinho's strategy to optimize the squad's performance as the new season commences.

health.title: Quitting Alcohol Can Change the Brain in Surprising Ways, Mouse Study Finds
health.summary: A study on mice revealed that abstinence from alcohol led to increased activity in the BNST region of the brain. This heightened activity was associated with later compulsive-like drinking behaviors. The findings suggest that a period of sobriety may not prevent future compulsive drinking in some individuals, highlighting potential changes in brain function related to alcohol consumption.

health.title: Women’s Health Is Precision Medicine’s Unfinished Business: A Q&A With Basmah Safdar
health.summary: Basmah Safdar, MD, emphasizes the importance of precision medicine in women's health, highlighting that biological differences between sexes affect health outcomes and clinical care. She points out that inadequate sex-specific data leads to healthcare inefficiencies, increased costs, and less effective treatments. Safdar advocates for a more tailored approach to women's health to improve diagnosis and treatment effectiveness.

health.title: Not All Exercise Is Equal: How Physical Activity Type May Shape Dementia Risk
health.summary: A meta-analysis indicates that leisure-time physical activity is associated with a reduced risk of dementia, while occupational physical activity may increase this risk. The findings suggest that the type and context of physical activity significantly influence brain health outcomes. This research highlights the importance of considering both the nature and setting of physical activity in dementia prevention strategies.

science.title: New images show moon crater carved by SpaceX rocket
science.summary: NASA has released new images showing the crater created by a SpaceX rocket crash on the moon, captured by a spacecraft in lunar orbit. The photos, released on Tuesday, provide the clearest views of the impact site. The Falcon rocket's upper stage collided with the moon, resulting in the formation of the visible crater.

science.title: Watch: Indian-origin Nasa astronaut Anil Menon takes second spacewalk
science.summary: Indian-origin astronaut Anil Menon conducted his second spacewalk outside the International Space Station on Tuesday. He was accompanied by NASA astronaut Jessica Meir. This spacewalk lasted six hours and 27 minutes. Menon had previously completed his first spacewalk earlier in the month. The mission highlights ongoing contributions of astronauts to scientific research and international collaboration in space exploration.

science.title: Energy-based identification of characteristic stresses in weakly cemented rocks during stepwise cyclic loading-unloading
science.summary: This study investigates weakly cemented rocks through stepwise cyclic loading-unloading tests on argillaceous siltstone. It analyzes energy partitioning during loading-unloading, separating elastic and dissipated energy. A quantitative method for identifying characteristic stresses, including closure stress, crack initiation stress, and damage stress, is proposed. Validation shows consistency with traditional methods, providing a robust framework for stress determination in weakly cemented rocks.

entertainment.title: Sagittarius Horoscope Today: August 19, 2026
entertainment.summary: Today, August 19, 2026, Sagittarius faces a significant decision, uncertain about taking a leap. The horoscope suggests that despite doubts, attempting to move forward is essential. There is a strong desire for family, connection, and partnership, both platonic and non-platonic. To achieve these relationships, self-reflection and proactive steps are necessary to foster meaningful connections.

entertainment.title: Taurus Horoscope Today: August 19, 2026
entertainment.summary: On August 19, 2026, Taurus individuals are advised to lower their defenses and focus on fostering peace. The horoscope suggests avoiding hasty reactions and instead emphasizes the importance of protecting what truly matters. This period encourages reflection and understanding, urging Taurus to create a harmonious environment while remaining vigilant about their goals and aspirations.

entertainment.summary: On August 19, 2026, Virgos may feel a sense of drifting but are encouraged to reassess their surroundings. The horoscope suggests that feelings of isolation stem from being with the wrong company rather than personal inadequacy.
